J2.evidence: Arabic: «والضميرُ في «به» يعودُ على مَنْ جَعَلَ «يَهْدي» حالاً منه أو صفة له». TR: '«به»deki zamir, «يَهْدي»yi kendisinden hâl veya kendisine sıfat kılanın (o kimsenin kabul ettiği kelimeye) döner.' The parenthetical '(o kimsenin kabul ettiği kelimeye)' is not in the Arabic; it is the translator's explanation of the elliptical على مَنْ جعل ('according to whoever makes يهدي a ḥāl of / ṣifa of it, [it refers to that word]') given unmarked. Must be inside a [Mütercim notu: …] (the same entry already uses a Mütercim notu for «السلام», showing the convention).

TR '«يَهْدي»yi kendisinden hâl veya kendisine sıfat kılanın (o kimsenin kabul ettiği kelimeye) döner' adds the explanatory phrase '(o kimsenin kabul ettiği kelimeye)', which is not in the Arabic and is not marked as a Mütercim notu. Fix: render the sentence literally and move the explanation into [Mütercim notu: …].
